channels_evaluated.target_audience: Senior developers, AI agent builders, startup engineers
channels_evaluated.rules: Show HNs are explicitly permitted to share projects and commercial products if work is substantial and technically detailed.
channels_evaluated.moderation_risk: LOW to MODERATE (Must focus on technical implementation and benchmarks, not marketing hype)

channels_evaluated.recommended_strategy: Technical post: "Show HN: We cut 60% token bloat in agent coding logs with a zero-dependency CLI". Provide the technical breakdown in text, link to Gumroad for convenience bundle.
